title: sweep() sends the vault's entire native balance to a caller-chosen recipient with no caller check
description: Discovery: Module A (Untrusted Recipient) / EXT-01. Confirms DP1-1 from the external-call angle: the recipient `to` is fully attacker-controlled and the amount is address(this).balance, ignoring the balances[] ledger. Cross-function: facts.json shows no guard on sweep while sibling setFee uses onlyOwner.
root_cause: A native-value transfer to an arbitrary address is reachable by any caller and is not bounded by any per-user accounting.

harm.magnitude: 100% of the vault's native balance per call

exploit_trace: 1. Users call depositEth(), vault holds N wei.
3. to.transfer(address(this).balance) sends N wei to attacker; balances[] entries remain but are unbacked.

preconditions.text: vault holds a non-zero native balance

postconditions.text: ETH credits in balances[] are unbacked

depth_evidence: [VARIATION:to=EOA→success; to=contract needing >2300 gas→revert, attacker uses EOA]
postconditions_created: ETH credits in balances[] are unbacked

title: withdraw() pays out ERC20 against a ledger that also holds unrelated ETH credits, letting an ETH depositor take other users' tokens
description: Discovery: Module S-style cross-state check / token-flow tracing. Confirms DP1-2: the outgoing token.transfer in withdraw() is not tied to the asset that created the credit. Value out (token units) is not matched by value in (wei) because depositEth credits the same balances[] slot used for token accounting.
root_cause: One mapping represents claims on two different assets; withdraw() always settles in the ERC20.

harm.magnitude: up to the vault's whole token balance, for the same count of wei

exploit_trace: 1. Victims deposit 1,000,000 token units via deposit().
3. Attacker calls withdraw(1_000_000): balances debit passes, token.transfer sends 1,000,000 token units to attacker.
4. Attacker later recovers the wei via sweep(); victims' tokens are gone.

preconditions.text: vault holds tokens deposited by others

postconditions.text: token holdings below sum of token depositors' balances

postconditions_created: token holdings below sum of token depositors' balances
